title: Working with standards
summary: Learn how to treat published standards as controlled references rather than informal suggestions.
contentNotice: Demonstration learning content for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy, curriculum or language instruction and must be reviewed before operational use.

sections.heading: Read the record, not only the headline

blocks.text: A standard should be read together with its owner, version, status and review information. Those details establish whether the reference is current and who is responsible for it.

steps.title: Check the current version
steps.text: Confirm that the item is current rather than archived or under review.

steps.title: Identify the owner
steps.text: Direct clarification to the person or function responsible for the standard.

steps.title: Preserve the uncertainty
steps.text: Do not turn an interpretation into a new rule without a documented decision.
